name: College Event - Coordinator Report
query: SELECT event_coordinator as "Coordinator:Link/Employee:150", COUNT(name) as "Events Coordinated:Int:120", SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Completed:Int:100" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE event_coordinator IS NOT NULL AND event_coordinator != '' GROUP BY event_coordinator ORDER BY `Events Coordinated` DESC

name: College Event - Winner Report
query: SELECT ce.event_name as "Event:Link/College Event:200", ew.student as "Student:Link/Admission Student:150", ew.rank as "Rank:Data:100", ew.prize as "Prize:Data:150", ew.cash_prize as "Cash Prize:Currency:100", ew.certificate_issued as "Certificate Issued:Check:100" FROM `tabEvent Winner` ew INNER JOIN `tabCollege Event` ce ON ce.name = ew.parent ORDER BY ce.event_name

name: College Event - Budget Report
query: SELECT name as "Event:Link/College Event:150", event_name as "Event Name:Data:200", budget as "Budget:Currency:100", actual_expense as "Actual Expense:Currency:120", (budget - actual_expense) as "Variance:Currency:100" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE budget IS NOT NULL AND budget > 0 ORDER BY starts_on DESC

name: College Event - Certificate Report
query: SELECT name as "Certificate No:Link/Event Certificate:150", event as "Event:Link/College Event:200", student as "Student:Link/Admission Student:150", issue_date as "Issue Date:Date:100", status as "Status:Data:100" FROM `tabEvent Certificate` ORDER BY issue_date DESC

name: College Event - Attendance Report
query: SELECT ea.student as "Student:Link/Admission Student:150", ce.event_name as "Event:Link/College Event:200", ea.attendance as "Attendance:Data:100", ea.late_entry as "Late Entry:Check:80", ea.certificate_issued as "Certificate Issued:Check:100" FROM `tabEvent Attendance` ea INNER JOIN `tabCollege Event` ce ON ce.name = ea.parent ORDER BY ce.event_name

name: College Event - Student Participation Report
query: SELECT er.student as "Student:Link/Admission Student:150", ce.event_name as "Event:Link/College Event:200", ce.event_category as "Category:Data:120", er.registration_date as "Registered On:Date:100", er.status as "Status:Data:100" FROM `tabEvent Registration` er INNER JOIN `tabCollege Event` ce ON ce.name = er.parent ORDER BY er.registration_date DESC

name: College Event - Club-wise Events
query: SELECT club as "Club:Link/Student Club:150", COUNT(name) as "Total Events:Int:100", SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Completed:Int:100", SUM(current_participants) as "Total Participants:Int:120" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE club IS NOT NULL AND club != '' GROUP BY club ORDER BY `Total Events` DESC

name: College Event - Department-wise Events
query: SELECT organizing_department as "Department:Link/Department:150", COUNT(name) as "Total Events:Int:100", SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Completed:Int:100", SUM(current_participants) as "Total Participants:Int:120" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE organizing_department IS NOT NULL AND organizing_department != '' GROUP BY organizing_department ORDER BY `Total Events` DESC

name: College Event - Completed Events
query: SELECT name as "Event:Link/College Event:150", event_name as "Event Name:Data:200", event_category as "Category:Data:120", starts_on as "Starts On:Datetime:150", current_participants as "Participants:Int:100", actual_expense as "Actual Expense:Currency:120" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE status = 'Completed' ORDER BY starts_on DESC

name: College Event - Upcoming Events
query: SELECT name as "Event:Link/College Event:150", event_name as "Event Name:Data:200", event_category as "Category:Data:120", starts_on as "Starts On:Datetime:150", venue as "Venue:Data:120", registration_status as "Registration:Data:100" FROM `tabCollege Event` WHERE status = 'Upcoming' AND approval_status = 'Approved' ORDER BY starts_on ASC

name: Academic Calendar - Calendar Report
query: SELECT ac.name as "Calendar:Link/Academic Calendar:150", ac.academic_year as "Academic Year:Link/Academic Year:100", ac.status as "Status:Data:100", COUNT(ace.name) as "Total Events:Int:100", SUM(CASE WHEN ace.status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Pending:Int:80", SUM(CASE WHEN ace.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Completed:Int:90" FROM `tabAcademic Calendar` ac LEFT JOIN `tabAcademic Calendar Event` ace ON ace.parent = ac.name GROUP BY ac.name ORDER BY ac.creation DESC

name: Academic Calendar - Overdue Activities
query: SELECT ace.parent as "Calendar:Link/Academic Calendar:150", ace.activity as "Activity:Data:180", ace.start_date as "Start Date:Date:100", DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), ace.start_date) as "Days Overdue:Int:100" FROM `tabAcademic Calendar Event` ace INNER JOIN `tabAcademic Calendar` ac ON ac.name = ace.parent WHERE ac.status IN ('Approved', 'Active') AND ace.status = 'Pending' AND ace.start_date < CURDATE() ORDER BY ace.start_date ASC

name: Academic Calendar - Upcoming Activities
query: SELECT ace.parent as "Calendar:Link/Academic Calendar:150", ace.activity as "Activity:Data:180", ace.start_date as "Start Date:Date:100", DATEDIFF(ace.start_date, CURDATE()) as "Days Away:Int:100" FROM `tabAcademic Calendar Event` ace INNER JOIN `tabAcademic Calendar` ac ON ac.name = ace.parent WHERE ac.status IN ('Approved', 'Active') AND ace.status = 'Pending' AND ace.start_date > CURDATE() ORDER BY ace.start_date ASC

name: Academic Calendar - Event Status Overview
query: SELECT ace.parent as "Calendar:Link/Academic Calendar:150", ace.activity as "Activity:Data:180", ace.start_date as "Start Date:Date:100", ace.end_date as "End Date:Date:100", ace.status as "Status:Data:100", CASE WHEN ace.status = 'Pending' AND ace.start_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Overdue' WHEN ace.status = 'Pending' AND ace.start_date = CURDATE() THEN 'Today' WHEN ace.status = 'Pending' AND ace.start_date > CURDATE() THEN 'Upcoming' ELSE ace.status END as "Timeline:Data:100" FROM `tabAcademic Calendar Event` ace INNER JOIN `tabAcademic Calendar` ac ON ac.name = ace.parent WHERE ac.status IN ('Approved', 'Active') ORDER BY ace.start_date ASC

name: Placement Pending Offers
query: SELECT po.name as "Offer:Link/Placement Offer:120", pr.student_name as "Student:Data:150", po.company as "Company:Link/Placement Company:150", po.package as "Package:Currency:100", po.offer_date as "Offer Date:Date:100", po.status as "Status:Data:100" FROM `tabPlacement Offer` po LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Registration` pr ON po.registration = pr.name WHERE po.status = 'Offer Made' ORDER BY po.offer_date ASC

name: Placement Drive Eligibility Summary
query: SELECT pd.drive_title as "Drive:Link/Placement Drive:150", pd.company as "Company:Link/Placement Company:150", COUNT(pr.name) as "Total Applications:Int:120", SUM(CASE WHEN pr.eligible=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Eligible:Int:80", SUM(CASE WHEN pr.eligible=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Not Eligible:Int:100" FROM `tabPlacement Drive` pd LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Registration` pr ON pr.drive = pd.name GROUP BY pd.name ORDER BY pd.drive_date DESC

name: Placement Company-wise Summary
query: SELECT pc.company_name as "Company:Data:150", COUNT(DISTINCT pd.name) as "Drives Conducted:Int:100", COUNT(DISTINCT po.name) as "Offers Made:Int:100", ROUND(AVG(po.package),2) as "Average Package:Currency:120", MAX(po.package) as "Highest Package:Currency:120" FROM `tabPlacement Company` pc LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Drive` pd ON pd.company = pc.name LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Offer` po ON po.company = pc.name GROUP BY pc.name ORDER BY `Offers Made` DESC

name: Placement Selected Students
query: SELECT pr.student_name as "Student:Data:150", pr.program as "Program:Link/Program:120", pd.drive_title as "Drive:Link/Placement Drive:150", pd.company as "Company:Link/Placement Company:150", po.package as "Package (LPA):Currency:100", po.role as "Role:Data:150", po.offer_date as "Offer Date:Date:100", po.status as "Offer Status:Data:100", po.joining_status as "Joining Status:Data:100" FROM `tabPlacement Registration` pr LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Drive` pd ON pr.drive = pd.name LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Offer` po ON po.registration = pr.name WHERE pr.application_status IN ('Selected','Offer Released') ORDER BY po.offer_date DESC

name: Placement Application Summary
query: SELECT pr.name as "Registration:Link/Placement Registration:150", pr.student_name as "Student:Data:150", pr.program as "Program:Link/Program:120", pr.study_year as "Study Year:Data:80", pd.drive_title as "Drive:Link/Placement Drive:150", pd.company as "Company:Link/Placement Company:150", pr.percentage as "Percentage:Percent:100", pr.current_backlogs as "Backlogs:Int:80", pr.eligible as "Eligible:Check:80", pr.application_status as "Status:Data:120", pr.applied_on as "Applied On:Date:100" FROM `tabPlacement Registration` pr LEFT JOIN `tabPlacement Drive` pd ON pr.drive = pd.name ORDER BY pr.applied_on DESC

name: Scholarship Disbursement by Scheme
query: SELECT sch.name as "Scheme:Link/Scholarship Scheme:180", sch.academic_year as "Academic Year:Link/Academic Year:100", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabScholarship Application` sa WHERE sa.scheme = sch.name) as "Applications:Int:100", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ss.sanction_amount),0) FROM `tabScholarship Sanction` ss INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Application` sa2 ON sa2.name = ss.application WHERE sa2.scheme = sch.name) as "Total Sanctioned:Currency:140", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp.amount),0) FROM `tabScholarship Payment` sp INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Sanction` ss2 ON ss2.name = sp.sanction INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Application` sa3 ON sa3.name = ss2.application WHERE sa3.scheme = sch.name AND sp.status = 'Completed') as "Total Paid:Currency:140", ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ss3.sanction_amount),0) FROM `tabScholarship Sanction` ss3 INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Application` sa4 ON sa4.name = ss3.application WHERE sa4.scheme = sch.name) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp2.amount),0) FROM `tabScholarship Payment` sp2 INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Sanction` ss4 ON ss4.name = sp2.sanction INNER JOIN `tabScholarship Application` sa5 ON sa5.name = ss4.application WHERE sa5.scheme = sch.name AND sp2.status = 'Completed')) as "Pending Disbursement:Currency:140" FROM `tabScholarship Scheme` sch ORDER BY sch.creation DESC
